/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.labels=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
        if tag=='label' and 'for' in a:self.labels.append(a['for'])
p=Check();p.feed(s)
assert len(p.ids)==len(set(p.ids)), 'Duplicate ids'
assert all(i in p.ids for i in p.labels), 'Missing label target'
Path('/tmp/sam-priya-current-inline.js').write_text(s.split('<script>')[1].split('</script>')[0])
print('HTML labels and IDs checked.')
PY
node --check /tmp/sam-priya-current-inline.js"
